context_length: Trained on sequences of up to about 2,048 residues; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The 600M ESM Cambrian encoder; reportedly rivals ESM-2 3B while being far smaller, producing 1152-dim embeddings.
architecture: Encoder-only masked transformer in the ESM-C representation line; 1152-dim per-residue embeddings.
pretraining_data: Large-scale natural protein sequence corpora (EvolutionaryScale; see the ESM-C release).
key_innovations: 600M reportedly matches ESM-2 3B and approaches the 15B model at a fraction of the size
when_to_use: When you want near-ESM-2-3B quality without the 3B footprint; a strong modern default in the mid-size range (1152-dim).
caveats: Documented mainly via the EvolutionaryScale release/blog and independent evaluations rather than a peer-reviewed paper; verify specifics before relying on exact numbers.
